title: VTC Directory — Card — Public — payload
description: Read a member's external card, as they signed it. Anyone may ask; the request carries nothing about the reader. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cardDigest.description: The card the reader expects, from a registry pointer. Where the card served now is another, the answer is `notFound`.

Response.title: VTC Directory — Card — Public — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/card/public/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/card/public/0.1#response.

card.description: Exactly as the member signed it.
